summary: Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners II Co. (ATII) filed an 8-K announcing a PIPE financing in connection with its proposed business combination with Forge Nano. The subscription agreements provide for the sale of 2,300,000 Pubco common shares at $10.00 per share, generating $23M gross proceeds, closing concurrently with the merger. The PIPE shares are issued in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act. This is a SPAC-related capital raise tied to the de-SPAC transaction. Watch for shareholder approval and merger closing conditions; risk-arb focuses on deal completion and redemption levels.
